match: ^'([^']+)' is (?:assigned a value but never used|defined but never used)\.?$
samples: 'count' is assigned a value but never used.
what: ESLint found a variable that is declared but never used.

street.headline: You create `{1}`, but you never use am
street.happen: ESLint see `{1}` declared, but nothing dey use am. E no dey break the app, but e dey confuse readers and fit hide a mistake.
street.todo: Use am, or remove am if you no need am.
street.learn: "unused" mean say you create am but you no use am.

normal.headline: `{1}` dey declared, but nothing dey use am
normal.happen: ESLint found `{1}` declared but never used. It will not break the app, but it makes the code harder to follow.
normal.todo: Use am, or remove am if you no need am.
normal.learn: "unused" mean say you create am but you no use am.
